hooks.command: f=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')).tool_input.file_path" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.gd) out=$("../Godot_v4.6.1-stable_win64_console.exe" --path . --headless --check-only --script "$f" 2>&1 | grep "Parse Error"); [ -n "$out" ] && { echo "GDScript parse errors in $f:" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; true
